hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, for example astrocytes, APOE4 causes impaired ARF6-related recycling of receptors between the cell surface and the endosome, compared with APOE3.
A: APOE genotype or apoE isoform (APOE4 vs APOE3)
B: ARF6-related recycling of receptors between the cell surface and the endosome (e.g. ABCA1, LRP1, receptor surface levels, recycling rate)
scope: IN: recycling of receptors between cell surface and endosomes (surface levels of receptors such as ABCA1, LRP1, LDLR, ApoER2, glutamate receptors; internalization and recycling rates; Rab11/Rab4 recycling-compartment localization; receptor retention in late endosomes), and ARF6 abundance/activity and its manipulation, in an APOE4 vs APOE3 context or a rescue in APOE4 cells. OUT: receptor transcription without trafficking readouts, downstream functions (cholesterol efflux, amyloid clearance) unless used as the only surrogate of recycling, unrelated signalling.
